title: 第1章 骨气第2章 十个呼吸气血诞生
slug: 满级武圣从绝世神功开始
content_zh:
归元派，外门弟子住宿区。
“咚咚咚”。
一阵密集的敲门声响起。
“张宿，你家老仆来了，就在山门外等着。”
大门打开，张宿走了出来。
他眼神中还有些迷茫，似乎在回忆着什么。
“是了，今天是月初，多半是管伯又来送银子了……”
张宿当即朝着山门外走去。
很快，他就看到了一道熟悉的身影。
那是一个老仆。
佝偻着身子，正朝着山门内张望。
“管伯。”
张宿迅速走了过去。
管伯看到张宿后，脸上露出了一抹笑容，快步走了上来，笑着说道：“二少爷，大少爷每月给您的五百两银子，已经存进您在归元派的身份牌上了。”
“另外，这是大少爷专门托人采购的补血丸，对练武有好处，还有……”
管伯带了许多东西。
张宿知道，这都是他记忆中“大哥”给他带来的东西。
他和大哥之间的关系，很复杂。
他单方面宣布，和大哥断绝关系。
可大哥依旧每月让管伯带银子，带补品上山给自己。

看到张宿沉默，管伯长叹了一声。
却什么都没有说。
他是张家老仆了。
对张家的事很清楚。
可对于大少爷与二少爷之间的事，他也只能在心中叹息。
“大哥……还好吧。”
许久，张宿缓缓开口了。
“嗯？”
管伯猛地抬起头。
他有多久没从张宿口中听到“大哥”这个称呼了？
“二少爷，您……”
管伯很激动。
难道二少爷原谅大少爷了？
张宿深吸了口气，随即开口道：“管伯，回去替我谢谢大哥。”
“好，我一定把话带到！大少爷一定很高兴……”
管伯擦了擦眼泪。
他太激动了。
张家现在就剩下大少爷、二少爷以及小姐了。
content_en:
Guiyuan Sect, the accommodation area for outer disciples.
"Dong dong dong".
There was a series of knocks on the door.
"Zhang Su, your old servant is here, waiting outside the mountain gate."
The door opened and Zhang Su walked out.
There was still confusion in his eyes, as if he was remembering something.
"Yes, today is the beginning of the month, and the steward is probably here to send money again..."
Zhang Su immediately walked towards the mountain gate.
Soon, he saw a familiar figure.
That's an old servant.
He was hunched over and looking into the mountain gate.
"Uncle Guan."
Zhang Su quickly walked over.
When Uncle Guan saw Zhang Su, a smile appeared on his face, he walked up quickly and said with a smile: "Second Young Master, the five hundred taels of silver that the Eldest Young Master gives you every month has been deposited into your identity card in the Guiyuan Sect."
"In addition, this is a blood-enhancing pill specially purchased by the young master. It is good for martial arts training, and..."
The steward brought many things.
Zhang Su knew that these were all things his "big brother" brought to him in his memory.
The relationship between him and his eldest brother is very complicated.
He unilaterally announced that he would sever ties with his eldest brother.
But the eldest brother still asked the steward to bring money and supplements to the mountain for him every month.
Seeing Zhang Su's silence, Guan Bo sighed.
But said nothing.
He is an old servant of the Zhang family.
He is very clear about the Zhang family.
But regarding the matter between the eldest young master and the second young master, he could only sigh in his heart.
"Brother... are you okay?"
After a long time, Zhang Su slowly spoke.
"Huh?"
Guan Bo suddenly raised his head.
How long had it been since he heard the title "eldest brother" from Zhang Su?
"Second Young Master, you..."
The steward was very excited.
Could it be that the second young master has forgiven the eldest young master?
Zhang Su took a deep breath, and then said: "Uncle Guan, go back and thank brother for me."
"Okay, I will definitely bring the message to you! The young master must be very happy..."
Guan Bo wiped his tears.
He was so excited.
The eldest young master, second young master and young lady are the only ones left in the Zhang family.
